title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
authors: Y. Wang, Y. Kordi, S. Mishra, A. Liu, N. Smith, D. Khashabi, H. Hajishirzi
before: Instruction tuning needed human-written instruction-response pairs.
problem: Writing tens of thousands of examples by hand is slow and expensive.
breakthrough: Bootstrap from a small seed set: have the model write new instructions and answers, filter, and train on the result.
why: It made instruction data nearly free, which is how small open models caught up so quickly in 2023.
next: Alpaca applied it to GPT-3.5 outputs; the synthetic data line runs on to phi and beyond.
inherits: Synthetic instruction data as a normal ingredient.
